test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question: What do you understand by the term ‘instant coffee attitude’?

options.text: Keeping up with the latest trends

solution:
The correct answer is "​**Expecting quick results**" 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The **theme **of the comprehension is that one needs **perseverance **and a **patient **attitude to **learn piano **and there are no instant lessons or shortcuts.
 
• In the **last **sentence of the **last **paragraph. It states that the **instant coffee **attitude implies the **short**-**lived **or instant **solutions **which often leads to the wrong track.

**Thus, the correct answer is option 1**
